schema:name: Liu et al. 2016 (M&PS 51) Tissint martian meteorite Phosphate (merrillite) Spot analysis LA-Q-ICP-MS Virginia Tech
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Liu et al. 2016 (M&PS 51) Tissint martian meteorite Phosphate (merrillite) Spot analysis LA-Q-ICP-MS Virginia Tech (column Y of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v2.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).
ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished thin section (same sections as silicate protocol)
ada:laserManufacturerModel: GeoLasPro 193 nm Excimer laser-ablation system (same as silicate protocol)
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element IS: EMP CaO concentration used; LA-ICP-MS 40Ca counts normalized to CaO from EMP analysis at the same spot
ada:internalStandardElement: 40Ca; CaO wt% from EMP at the analysis spot
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: External calibration using NIST 610; EMP CaO as IS corrects for ablation yield; no explicit downhole correction described
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Time-lapse plots examined; only plateau region used (same as silicate protocol)
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: 50 s background measurement before each analysis (same as silicate protocol)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Coupling Description
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: EPMA provides CaO concentration at exact analysis spot, used as internal standard for LA-ICP-MS data reduction (LA-ICP-MS 40Ca counts normalized to EMP CaO)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Drift Monitor Frequency
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: NIST 610 analyzed before and after every session (same as silicate protocol)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: No post-acquisition normalization; EMP CaO applied directly as IS; NIST 610 for external calibration

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Additional Notes
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: N/A — see silicate column for general notes
